summary: First-run comprehensive test for FMCG FieldForce Pro MVP. Ran 16 pytest cases covering auth, dashboard, retailers CRUD, products/brands, schemes, visits, orders, collections and role isolation - ALL 16 PASS after fixing one backend datetime bug. Ran mobile UI (390x844) Playwright flow covering login, home KPIs, beat, retailers list+search, retailer detail, start/complete visit, order booking with scheme auto-calc and collection - ALL WORKING. Fixed backend bug: GET /api/retailers/{id} returned 500 for retailers with orders due to naive-vs-aware datetime comparison. No deprecated Expo packages detected. testIDs present on all critical interactive elements.

minor.issue: FIXED by testing agent: naive vs aware datetime comparison caused 500 when retailer had orders. Added _aware() helper in server.py line ~287.

integration_issues.issue: React Native Alert.alert on web blocks until user clicks OK; navigation (router.replace/back) runs from Alert callback so it works with a real user but auto-tests must dismiss window.alert. Not a real bug, but consider replacing with a toast for smoother web/E2E behavior.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents.' Likely from a dependency; low priority but should be tracked.

action_items: (Optional) Replace Alert.alert() confirmations after order/collection/retailer submit with an inline toast or auto-dismiss so the app immediately navigates without requiring web alert dismissal.
(Optional) Populate /app/memory/test_credentials.md with the demo credentials from server.py seed for future testing agents.
(Optional) Investigate the 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' warning to eliminate console noise.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py stores tz-aware datetimes via now_utc() but Motor/PyMongo returns them naive on read. Fixed in get_retailer, but the same pattern exists in visits complete (`v['start_time'].replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)` handles it) and in dashboard (`o.get('created_at')` compared with tz-aware today_start). The dashboard filter is done in the Mongo query (`$gte`) so it's fine because Mongo compares in UTC regardless. Recommend a shared _aware() helper if any future in-Python datetime comparison is added.
server.py POST /api/retailers returns a doc that includes 'created_at'/'updated_at' as datetime; FastAPI serializes fine but confirm client parsing.
Frontend Alert.alert used for post-action confirmation would be better replaced by toast for a mobile-first feel and to unblock automation.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (login, home KPIs, beat, retailers list+search, retailer detail, start/complete visit, order booking with DHAMAL 10-slab scheme=Insulated Tiffin, order submission, collection outstanding+submit, add retailer form)

seed_data_creation: Test suite created a few TEST_-prefixed retailers via POST /api/retailers; auto-seed populates 6 users, 14 products, 4 brands, 2 schemes, 50 retailers, 6 beats and 2 targets.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL env var is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL). All 16 pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py should stay green. Salesperson EMP003/sales@123 has beats for weekdays Mon-Sat (5 retailers each). Collections reduce retailer.outstanding via $inc. Order + scheme flow verified with DHAMAL qty=10 -> Insulated Tiffin.
rca_of_issue: Root cause of the 500 in GET /api/retailers/{id}: MongoDB (via Motor) returns stored tz-aware datetimes as naive UTC on read. Comparing naive `o['created_at']` with the tz-aware `cm_start` raised TypeError. Fix: wrap the read value with a _aware() helper that adds tzinfo=UTC when missing before comparing.
